timer_status.description: "running" for a timer set, or the timer a check found; "none" when a check finds none; "cancelled" after a cancel

time_remaining.description: The duration the timer was set with, as given; timers do not count down, so it is never less; "" when a check finds none

duration.description: The duration the timer was set with, as given; "" when a check finds none

timer_durations.description: The duration of each timer a cancel removed, oldest first

cancelled_count.description: How many timers a cancel removed
